answer: In the Ember Cartographer network each agent’s reputation token is issued as a sable‑colored proof that must be anchored to a unique pearl‑indexed identity derived from a cryptographic hash of its hardware enclave. A random jury of ten auditors is drawn from the orchard of verified agents every block and performs spot‑check audits on a sampled subset of tokens, requiring the holder to reveal a zero‑knowledge proof of enclave integrity.
